description: Search Scopus institution profiles using native affiliation query syntax. Returns one page of native Elsevier JSON, including search-results and pagination. Example: AFFIL(university) AND AFFIL(London). Credentials come from the server environment. Access depends on your Scopus entitlements.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for one Scopus affiliation search page. Offset pagination is limited to start + count <= 5000.

count.description: Maximum results in this page, from 0 to 200. Defaults to 25.

field.description: Comma-separated response fields, e.g. identifier,affiliation-name. Overrides view; omitted fields remain absent in the response.

query.description: Native affiliation query, e.g. AFFIL(university) AND AFFIL(London).

reqId.description: Caller-supplied request identifier for Elsevier support.

sort.description: Up to three comma-separated sort fields; + ascending, - descending, e.g. -document-count,+affiliation-name.

start.description: Zero-based result offset. The requested window start + count must not exceed 5000; omitted count means 25.

suppressNavLinks.description: Suppress top-level navigation links. Omitted values use the API default of false.

ver.description: Resource version flags: facetexpand, allexpand, new; comma or semicolon separated.

view.description: Response view. STANDARD is the default and only supported view; overridden by field.

name: affiliation_search

outputSchema.description: Unmodified JSON envelope returned by the Affiliation Search API.

search-results.description: Native affiliation search response, including page metadata and entries.

dc:identifier.description: Scopus affiliation identifier, including its AFFILIATION_ID prefix when supplied.

document-count.description: Document count for the affiliation, retained as the string returned by Elsevier.

eid.description: Scopus electronic identifier (EID) of the affiliation profile.

error.description: Entry-level message returned by Elsevier, including no-result entries.

@ref.description: Relation of the linked resource, as returned by Elsevier.

link.description: Links associated with this affiliation profile.

name-variant.description: Alternative affiliation names reported by Elsevier.

parent-affiliation-id.description: Scopus ID of the parent affiliation, when supplied.

prism:url.description: Elsevier API URL for the affiliation profile.

entry.description: Affiliation profiles for this page, or native entry-level messages. Fields depend on field selection and entitlements.

@ref.description: Relation of the linked resource, as returned by Elsevier.

link.description: Response and pagination links supplied by Elsevier.

@role.description: Role of the query in the OpenSearch response.

@startPage.description: Starting page reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

opensearch:Query.description: OpenSearch metadata for the executed query.

opensearch:itemsPerPage.description: Page size reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

opensearch:startIndex.description: Zero-based offset of this page, retained as a string.

opensearch:totalResults.description: Total matching affiliations reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

title: Affiliation Search
